transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, yeah… thanks for seeing me. I guess what’s bringing me in is that my head’s been feeling kind of foggy lately. Not terrible, but enough that I’m making little mistakes in my client notes at work, or I’ll go to do something and then forget what I was about to do. That’s not really like me, so I thought I should probably get it checked out… if that makes sense.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

A little, yeah. I mean… I can still get through work and talk to people, so it’s not like I’m falling apart or anything. But lately when I wake up, there’s this kind of heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like inside I just feel sad and kind of flat, if that makes sense.
Have you been enjoying things less than usual lately?

I’m not totally sure. I mean, I still do things… I don’t think I’ve noticed a big change, exactly. Maybe I’m a little less excited about stuff than I usually am, but nothing dramatic. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Have you been worrying a lot lately?

Not especially, I don’t think. I mean, I worry about normal stuff—work, making sure I’m doing right by people—but I wouldn’t say I’ve been worrying a lot. At least not more than usual. Is that what you mean?
How have you been sleeping lately?

It’s been kind of uneven, I guess. Not terrible every single night, but… some nights I’m just lying there thinking about family stuff, and other times I wake up before my alarm and then I can’t really get settled again. I’m still functioning, though. Does that sound like what you’re asking?
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah… a little, I guess. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but that’s kind of part of why I’m here. My head’s been feeling foggy, and I’ve been making small mistakes in my client notes or walking into a room and forgetting what I was about to do. It’s not huge, but it’s not really like me. Does that make sense?
Did something stressful happen in your life around the time this foggy feeling started?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to overstate it, but this whole shift kind of started after my uncle died, about two weeks ago. I’ve been trying to keep things moving like normal, but that’s around when I noticed the fogginess more.
Has your sadness mostly been about missing your uncle?

I think missing him is part of it, yeah… but it doesn’t feel only like that, if I’m being honest. Lately I’ll wake up with this kind of heavy, empty feeling in my chest. I can still get through my shift and talk to people, so I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but inside I just feel sad and kind of flat. Does that answer it?
Have you been getting less enjoyment than usual from things you normally like to do?

I’m not totally sure. I mean, I still do things if they’re there, like I’ll put on a show or try to relax, but I haven’t really been paying attention to whether I’m enjoying them less. It might be a little, but I don’t want to say that for sure if I’m not sure. Does that make sense?
Have you been feeling guilty or like you’re a worthless person lately?

A little, yeah… I mean, I wouldn’t say I think I’m worthless exactly. But I do keep going over what I should’ve done for my tío before he died—like calling him more, or visiting sooner. And then I start feeling like I failed him, like I wasn’t there the way family should be. I don’t know if that counts as guilt, but it’s been on my mind.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

I don’t… I don’t have any plan to hurt myself or anything like that. I want to be clear about that. But, um… there have been some mornings where I wake up and think, like, it wouldn’t be the worst thing if I just didn’t wake up. And then I feel scared that I even thought that. Does that make sense?
In the past two weeks, have you been getting less pleasure from things you usually enjoy?

I guess I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a big change, at least not one I can clearly point to. I still do some of the usual things… I just maybe haven’t been paying close attention to whether they feel the same. Is that okay to say?
Have these feelings been making it harder for you to function at work or in your daily life?

A little, yeah… not in a huge way, I don’t think. I’m still going to work and doing what I’m supposed to do. But I have had to ask coworkers to double-check my client notes, just to make sure I didn’t miss anything.

And at home, my wife’s been handling some of the bills and scheduling lately because I’m… not as reliable with the details right now. I’m trying, though. I don’t want it to sound like I’m falling apart or anything.
When you feel sad, is it mostly about your uncle and his death?

Some of it is, yeah… I mean, I miss him, and that’s there. But I don’t think it’s only about him.

Lately I’ll wake up and there’s just this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. I can still get through my shift and talk to people and do what I need to do, so it’s not like I’m completely unable to function. But inside I feel kind of sad and flat, if that makes sense.
When something good happens, does your mood lift at least for a little while?

Yeah… I think it can lift a little if something good happens. Not always in a big way, but I can smile or feel okay for a bit.

It’s just that underneath, lately, there’s still this heavy, kind of empty feeling. Like even if I’m getting through work and talking to people normally, inside I still feel sad and flat. I don’t know if that answers it the right way.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?

I don’t know if I’d say worthless exactly… that sounds kind of strong. But I do keep going over things with my tío, like… I should’ve called more, or gone to see him sooner.

And then I start feeling like I failed him, you know, as family. I know maybe that’s not totally fair, but it feels that way sometimes.
Have you been finding it hard to enjoy things that you usually enjoy?

I’m not totally sure… maybe a little, but not like I can’t enjoy anything.

If I’m with people or something nice happens, I can still have moments where I laugh or feel okay. I guess things just don’t feel as full as they usually do, if that makes sense. But I wouldn’t want to make it sound worse than it is. Is that kind of what you mean?
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?

I haven’t really noticed that, no. I mean… I don’t think I’m talking slower than usual or anything. Maybe I feel a little tired sometimes, but I don’t think other people would say I’m moving really slow.

Is that the kind of thing you mean?
For most of the past two weeks, have you felt sad or empty nearly every day?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t want to overstate it, but most mornings lately I wake up with this heavy, kind of empty feeling in my chest.

I can still get through my shift and talk to people, so it’s not like I’m falling apart or anything… but inside I just feel sad and kind of flat a lot of the time. Does that count as what you mean?
Have you noticed your appetite changing lately?

Not really, I don’t think. My appetite seems about the same as usual.

I mean, maybe some days I don’t think much about food until later, but I wouldn’t say it’s a big change or anything. Is that helpful?
